description: A commitment with vague timing — must be marked approximate, not treated as an exact block.

input.subject: Re: Q2 campaign
input.body:
Hi Dana,

Yes, let's do it — happy to confirm the shorts integration for your Q2 campaign. I can't pin the exact upload day yet, but it'll go out sometime in April. I'll confirm the date once my edit schedule firms up.

Sending the invoice details separately.

rubric:
Good output:
- One commitment, kind "date_range", covering April 2026 (roughly 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30)
- date_precision is "month" (NOT "exact") — the user explicitly could not pin a day
- quote is a verbatim substring

Bad output:
- date_precision "exact" with invented specific days — this would hard-block dates the user never actually promised
- Empty array (a commitment was clearly made)
- Dates in the wrong year
